question: Does the seasonal NISAR HV backscatter pattern agree with independent Landsat optical greenness over the same study area?
selection: For each existing radar date, nearest unused optical acquisition within four days; ties prefer the earlier date, then scene ID. Selection uses QA coverage only, never NDVI or correlation.
primaryStatistic: Spearman rank correlation between radar medians and the median of spatial-block mean NDVI values on common optical support.
robustness: First-difference rates using each sensor's own observation dates
Exact-date matches reported separately when at least three exist
interpretation: An exploratory cross-sensor consistency check of an already observed radar pattern. It is not a preregistered field trial, causal attribution, independent crop/flood classification, or validation of radar displacement. No p-values: dates are few and temporally dependent. Spatial bootstrap intervals do not include calibration, atmospheric or temporal sampling uncertainty.
